name: Meeting Notes & Task Assistant | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Meeting Notes & Task Assistant
Paste a transcript or rough notes in the form (or send them to the webhook from your recorder), and the AI writes the summary, decisions, action items with owners and due dates, and open questions. The notes are emailed to the attendees and every action item is added to a **Tasks** sheet.
1. Fill in **Settings**. 2. Make a sheet with a **Tasks** tab (`tasks-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect OpenAI, Gmail and Google Sheets. 4. Activate and share the form.

parameters.formDescription: Paste the transcript or your notes. The summary and tasks arrive by email.
